_comment: TEST DIRECTORY (2026-07-16) — fabricated agents for on-device testing of the hosted-catalog pipeline. These render in PROD builds because 'sample' is false, so this file MUST be replaced with real onboarded agents (docs/AGENT_PITCH.md) before any build reaches a real user. Names/packages mirror the mock quotes used for AI-compare testing. WhatsApp numbers point at the owner's test number on purpose.

agents.name: Al-Haram Tours
agents.tagline: Bulk BLR→JED group fares — often beats solo booking
agents.about: Family-run since 2012, Al-Haram Tours runs weekly group departures from Bengaluru with negotiated airline allotments and long-standing hotel contracts in Makkah and Madinah. Nusuk visa and ground logistics handled end-to-end so first-time pilgrims travel worry-free.

packages.name: Economy Group
packages.blurb: 4-share rooms, 1500–2000m hotels with shuttle, 3 catered meals daily.

packages.name: Premium 5★
packages.blurb: Clock Tower / Movenpick, non-stop, private transfers.

reviews.author: Imran S.
reviews.text: Took my parents for Umrah. Visa, hotels, transport — everything was sorted. The team was reachable at all hours in Makkah.

reviews.author: Ayesha K.
reviews.text: Group fare was noticeably cheaper than what I found booking flights myself. Hotel was exactly as shown.

reviews.author: Faisal R.
reviews.text: Smooth overall. Coach to Madinah ran a little late but the rest was excellent and well organised.

agents.name: Madinah Star Travels
agents.about: Madinah Star Travels focuses on mid-range packages with genuinely close hotels — 700m in Makkah, 400m in Madinah — and direct BLR–JED flights on Saudia. Smaller groups of around 25 with airport transfers on both sides included.

packages.name: Comfort Silver
packages.blurb: Twin-share, 700m/400m hotels, direct flights, breakfast & dinner.

packages.name: Economy Silver
packages.blurb: 4-share (limited rooms), same close hotels, breakfast & dinner.

reviews.author: Zubair M.
reviews.text: Hotel really was walking distance — we made every prayer at the Haram. Direct flight both ways.

reviews.author: Farhana S.
reviews.text: Well organised smaller group. Dinner buffet was good; lunch on your own as they say upfront.

agents.name: Barakah Umrah Services
agents.tagline: Lowest-cost shared groups with an experienced muallim
agents.about: Barakah Umrah Services runs large budget groups of around 50 pilgrims with an experienced muallim travelling with every departure. Shuttle hotels and shared rooms keep the per-person price the lowest in the city.

packages.name: Economy Saver
packages.blurb: 4–5 share, 2.5km shuttle hotels, breakfast included, one-stop flights.

reviews.author: Abdul R.
reviews.text: Cheapest package I found and the muallim travelling with us made everything easy for first-timers.

reviews.author: Nusrath J.
reviews.text: Big group so some waiting for the shuttle, but honest about what is included and the price was unbeatable.
